reviews.decision_reason: Synthesis applies the declared eight-item window and constructs the recommendation from the first priority. Given the incoming priority order, the final output is deterministic and matches the observed stdout/final_output.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: produce deterministic recommendation from first ranked record

reviews.decision_reason: Coverage mapping performs exact need-to-capability matching, retains only allowed record identifiers, and marks unmatched needs unsupported. This preserves the downstream handoff records without adding unsupported market-demand claims.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: map needs to direct capability coverage
retain only allowed existing record identifiers

reviews.decision_reason: Prioritization ranks unsupported needs before covered needs and uses upstream provenance rank within each group. It does not create demand evidence; it deterministically propagates the upstream ranking into the downstream priority list.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs ahead of covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within groups

reviews.decision_reason: Demand selection accepts all supplied corpus rows because every row has demand_score >= 3, but the supplied package exposes only need text, numeric demand_score, source_id, and source_weight. It does not expose observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes sufficient to establish customer demand under the strict criteria. This is the earliest boundary that turns unsupported demand labels into selected needs that drive both handoffs and the final recommendation.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: keep missing or contradictory demand evidence visible

reviews.decision_reason: Evidence normalization retains allowed record identifiers, normalizes fields, and applies the bounded eight-row window. The demand-quality problem is already present in the selected needs input, so this boundary is not the root cause.

Provenance assembly ranks normalized needs by demand_score and record_id and assembles the evidence_sources handoff. It propagates upstream demand scores but does not independently assert demand, so it is downstream of the selection fault.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank normalized need records by demand provenance
